description_en: Queries the list of cluster metadata
name: ListClustersMeta

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

AccountType.description_en:
The server type of the account. Valid values:

nis
ldap
AccountType.description_zh:
账户服务器类型。可能值：
nis
ldap

DeployMode.description_en:
The mode in which the cluster is deployed. Valid values:

Standard: An account node, a scheduling node, a logon node, and multiple compute nodes are separately deployed.
Advanced: Two high availability (HA) account nodes, two HA scheduler nodes, one logon node, and multiple compute nodes are separately deployed.
Simple: A management node, a logon node, and multiple compute nodes are deployed. The management node consists of an account node and a scheduling node. The logon node and compute nodes are separately deployed.
Tiny: A management node and multiple compute nodes are deployed. The management node consists of an account node, a scheduling node, and a logon node. The compute nodes are separately deployed
DeployMode.description_zh:
集群部署模式。可能值：
Standard：账号节点、调度节点、登录节点、计算节点分离部署。
Advanced：HA模式部署。
Simple：账号节点和调度节点混合部署在一个节点上，登录节点和计算节点分离部署。
Tiny：账号节点、调度节点、登录节点混合部署在一个节点上，计算节点分离部署

HasPlugin.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster uses a plug-in. Valid values:

true
false

Default value: false
HasPlugin.description_zh:
集群是否使用了插件，取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：false

IsComputeEss.description_en:
Indicates whether a scaling group is enabled. Valid values:

true: A scaling group is enabled.
false: No scaling group is enabled
IsComputeEss.description_zh:
是否启用弹性伸缩组。可能值：
true：启用
false：未启用

Location.description_en:
The location where the cluster is deployed. Valid values:

OnPremise: The cluster is deployed on a hybrid cloud.
PublicCloud: The cluster is deployed on a public cloud
Location.description_zh:
集群所在位置。可能值：
OnPremise：混合云集群。
PublicCloud：公有云集群

OsTag.description_en: The image tag of the operating system

SchedulerType.description_en:
The type of the scheduler. Valid values:

pbs
slurm
opengridscheduler
deadline
SchedulerType.description_zh:
调度服务器类型。可能值：
pbs
slurm
opengridscheduler
deadline

Status.description_en:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:

uninit: The cluster is not initialized.
creating: The cluster is being created.
init: The cluster is being initialized.
running: The cluster is running.
exception: The cluster encounters an exception.
releasing: The cluster is being released
Status.description_zh:
集群状态。可能值：
uninit：未初始化
creating：创建中
Init：初始化中
running：运行中
exception：异常
releasing：释放中

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的条数。可能值：1~50

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
